final: WITH t AS (SELECT team_id, SUM(g - w) AS s FROM manager GROUP BY team_id), tot AS (SELECT SUM(s) AS total FROM t WHERE s IS NOT NULL), av AS (SELECT AVG(s) AS a FROM t WHERE s IS NOT NULL), j AS (SELECT t.s AS s, t.s * 1.0 / tot.total AS share, av.a AS a FROM t JOIN tot ON tot.total IS NOT NULL JOIN av ON av.a IS NOT NULL WHERE t.s > av.a) SELECT AVG(s) AS avg_sum, AVG(share) AS avg_share, AVG(s - a) AS avg_diff FROM j
